text: Most families make big money, housing and legal decisions without a lawyer, an accountant or a financial planner. iConcierge, your personal family office, gives every family a team.

Guest mode opens a private space, with no account. Each day, the team greets you with a Daily Update: one idea from each member, in their own voice, tied to an official source. All seven come from one cached AI call, about four hundredths of a cent.

Now a real question. We're moving out, and we want our security deposit back. Rosa, the Captain, picks the right specialists and assigns the work. Gold pings are assignments, blue is a calculator or a source lookup, green is findings coming back, and purple hands the work to Ari, my AI assistant. The meter on the right shows the spend, live.
The answer lays out options, not orders. It cites only vetted official sources, and it adds to-dos. Eight safety checks ran on it, from private numbers to tracing every figure back to a calculator.
Ari wrote the email to the landlord. I can edit it, then open it in Gmail, Outlook or my email app. The app never sends anything on its own.

In Lecture 12, hidden white text fooled an AI. This lease hides a two thousand dollar cleaning fee, paid by wire, in white text. iConcierge reads only what a person can see, and shows the family what it removed.
Everything works in six languages, and answers come at five explanation levels, from explain like I'm five, to professional.
That whole question took about half a minute, and cost a fraction of a cent. iConcierge: a family office for every family.
